messages:
jordan: CI microbench failing on PR #21456 — kv warmstart stall, tail p99 +18% after merge. stack: batcher + kv init? :eyes:
ci-bot: perf-ci: run 21456 / artifacts: https://ci.example/21456/artifacts
ci-bot: summary: kv_warmstart_microbench -- baseline: 12.4ms p99, head: 14.6ms p99 (+18%). diff exceeds threshold.
maya: ugh, I saw something similar on staging earlier. suspect KV cache warm path on sequence length > 1024.
sam: can you paste the microbench args? want to reproduce locally
jordan: args: `--bench kv_warmstart --seq-len 1536 --batch 8 --iters 1000`
sam: repro'ing now on my devbox (A100). running `./run_bench --bench kv_warmstart --seq 1536 --batch 8`
sam: got p99 14.4ms here. baseline (main@before) is 12.2ms. flamegraph attached
sam: ```
flamegraph top: kv_init -> kv_prefetch -> kernel_selector::calc_affinity -> allocate_slab
 samples: 48 30 18 12
```
luca: the kernel selector change from yesterday touched load balancing between concat kernel and split kernel, commit b3f2a4e.
zhen: that's the one I renamed to 'autoselect-v2' — it adjusted cost table heuristics for small batches.
maya: adding context: our CI microbench runs with cold KV cache; autoselect-v2 may prefer a kernel that has higher cold-path overhead.
jordan: ok let's bisect — can someone run `git bisect start HEAD main -- ./ci/scripts/run_microbench.sh kv_warmstart` ?
maya: I'll start bisect on CI mirror, posting results.
ci-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.example/bisect/21456
maya: first failing commit: b3f2a4e (autoselect-v2). reverting locally drops p99 back to 12.3ms
sam: confirmed revert drops p99 to 12.1ms. plan: open hotfix revert PR for the merge window, and add a microbench golden to protect.
jordan: agree. also add a small unit test for kernel choice on cold cache.
luca: created draft revert PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/21500 :assign @release
zhen: will follow up with perf-friendly tweak to autoselect cost model and a canary rollout after
maya: next steps: (1) merge revert PR to unblock rollout (2) add perf golden + CI guard (3) iterate on autoselect fix in separate PR
jordan: thanks all. filing incident note and will mark this as rollout blocker until revert merges :heavy_check_mark:
ci-bot: deploy gate blocked for PR #21456 until revert or perf fix merged
jordan: i'll ping SRE when revert is live
sam: :thumbsup:
